decision: Reject both BGE top-one empty-result rescue views. All 192 policies have zero complete-answer gains; 142 preserve every result and 50 change negative packets. Production MiniLM/model provisioning/release stay unchanged. Retain opt-in native CLS capability, reference exporter, frozen fixtures and evidence.

model.pooling: normalized unmasked first-token CLS, per official 1_Pooling config
model.provenance: Official pinned float32 ONNX artifact and LFS SHA-256.

compatibility.scope: Same official graph, exported native token inputs, independent normalized CLS calculation; not independent tokenizer/PyTorch parity.

checks.text: Café prices use exact decimal arithmetic.
Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: How can simultaneous readers stay safe?

compatibility.default_preprocessing: Masked mean, existing 500-character and 256-token native window; no production revision change.
compatibility.bge_preprocessing: Same native windows, normalized CLS; two registered query variants and unprefixed title-newline-claim documents. Distinct per-view vector revisions; no vector cache import/export.

fresh_suite.labels: Assistant-authored synthetic corpus review, not independent relevance judgments or agent task success.
fresh_suite.corpus: All sixteen real source facts remain visible to retrieval in both splits; reserved query rows are not scored.

analysis.method: For each registered view/floor/margin, keep every MiniLM row unless it is empty without query files. Use the BGE primary top-one and runner-up. Match the winner ID/hash to the MiniLM eligible pool and use that row’s actual native append preview, never the BGE packet preview. Recompute delivery/rank fields from actual preview IDs. Run unchanged memory-regressions comparator plus no-new-unrequired-positive-ID audit. Labels are used only for evaluation, not selection.
